text:
Michael: FYI our us-west-2 GPU compute savings plan + RI pool expires 2025-06-04 (in ~12 days). Need a quick utilization check and renewal recommendation.
ops-bot: Billing alert: Reserved Instances expiring for account Redwood-Prod in us-west-2. Coverage last 30d: 71%.
Anya: Can someone pull hourly covered vs on-demand for p4d/p3 over the last 90d? I want peak gaps and tail usage per workload.
Jordan: Quick CE export shows p4d covered ~68% (90d), p3 covered ~74%. On-demand GPU spend ~ $43k/mo last 30d. Projected q3 demand +12% if growth continues. Attached CSV -> s3://redwood-billing/analyses/1742104321-gpu-coverage.csv
Ken: If real coverage is ~68% we should NOT auto-renew at current commit. Proposal: scale committed pool down 25%, preserve a small canary reserve for prod latency-sensitive lanes, rely on spot/on-demand for spikes and non-prod. cc @Julie-Finance
Julie-Finance: Finance prefers locked commit for discount, but we need delta dollars. Ken, can you give rough projected savings vs on-demand overage if we reduce 25%? rough ballpark is ok.
Anya: Ran a quick sim based on tagged workloads: reduce 25% => committed fee down ~$12k/mo, expected on-demand/spike costs up ~$5k/mo (higher in peak weeks). Net ~ $7k/mo savings, plus more headroom for reallocating capacity. Assumptions: historical peak retained, 10% headroom buffer.
Michael: Sounds reasonable. Also think about region strategy — us-east-1 demand rising. Can we shift non-latency batch jobs to us-east-1 instead of keeping equivalent commit in us-west-2? That might reduce renewal need.
Alex: Cross-region shifts ok for batch/training but watch data egress and latency for certain eval jobs. Ops should prepare runbook and cost estimate for moving X workload class.
Jordan: I'll attach CE granularity exports per tag + hourly covered hours. Link in CSV above and I'll drop a short summary in the billing board.
Ken: Draft decision: propose reducing commit 25% for the upcoming renewal, keep flexible short-term burst policy (on-demand/spot). Move non-critical batch to us-east-1 where capacity cheaper. Send amendment to Sales/Legal to sign.
Julie-Finance: Provisional approval from Finance to reduce 25% pending final ROI calc. Need one more sign-off after Jordan's full CE export and Anya's per-workload sim.
Michael: Action items: (1) Jordan attach final CE exports and summary by EOD, (2) Anya run per-workload sensitivity sim and post numbers, (3) Ken draft renewal amendment & handoff to Legal, (4) Ops create playbook for cross-region batch migration. Target decision deadline 2025-06-03. :thumbsup:
Alex: noted, will start runbook and flag blockers in here.
Michael: thanks everyone — please post short updates in thread.
